scope: Program Phase 3 item 2: move Main's conversation-turn and focused-search state machines into tested Application coordinators behind thin native adapters, and make Main's same-frame process order explicit and checked, without behavior change.
changes: ConversationTurnCoordinator<TInput> (src/Application/Dialogue) owns submission acceptance, generation start and its context-budget refusal, single terminal-result consumption, participation continuation, player-dialogue occurrence and chain start, player cancel and the session reset of the three once-only fences.

FocusedSearchInputCoordinator (src/Application/Input) owns the cancel/complete/resolve/start actions, the prevalidated herb-patch world-event commit, wagon-clue routing, sabotage-evidence recovery and the result status.

ConversationTurnNodePorts and FocusedSearchInputNodePorts are plain C# adapters; each port member forwards to one existing node member. Main still calls both coordinators from _Process and _UnhandledInput, so checks that pause Main with SetProcess(false) pause the same work.

Main.ProcessPriority is explicitly -40 (MainProcessOrder.MainPriority); MainProcessOrder lists ten same-frame dependencies; the examination action is anchored immediately before WholeChannelPresentation instead of GetChildCount() - 2 (same index).
MainProcessOrderCheck.tscn asserts the priority, every dependency and the anchor; a swapped pair fails it with exit 1.
DialogueOwnershipMainSmokeCheck calls the coordinator's public steps and injects its transcript fault on CharacterTurnTranscriptController instead of reflecting on Main fields.

native.failure: ALLRPCS_ORDINARY_MODEL_FAILURE_CHECK=retry is intermittent and pre-existing: it failed 3 of 10 runs on unmodified main b0e390f5 and 1 of 13 runs on this branch (10 consecutive reruns passed). Not caused by this change; root cause not investigated in this slice.

verification.review: Independent behavior-preservation review found no differences; the items it could not diff against HEAD were cross-checked against b0e390f5 directly.
